title: Use standardized post-MVP commits and releases
abstract: For projects adopting maintained post-MVP governance, use agreed standardized commits, normally Conventional Commits, and consistent changelog/release discipline without rewriting history.

source.reference: General versioning or MVP graduation expectation, normalized without private conversation content

scope_hints.scope_boundary: Only an explicitly scoped MVP consideration or authorized inauguration; conditional on the project's actual kind and accepted requirements

unresolved: Compare with existing catalog rules and refine/reuse existing predicates rather than publish duplicates.
Preserve per-project applicability and do not infer an authorization to alter or release other repositories.
remarks: Queue-only atomic proposal, not processed or published; no release, repository modification or downstream task execution is authorized by this intake.
